prompt: As of 1st August 2024, Are the actors who play Summer and Luke in the OC in anything else together?
answer: Yes. **Rachel Bilson and Chris Carmack reunited on the TV series _Nashville_** in 2017. Bilson played **Alyssa Greene**, while Carmack continued as **Will Lexington**. So, as of August 1, 2024, _Nashville_ was the main project they had appeared in together after _The O.C._
